ideas: Charges reduce traffic and pollution in the centre
The money could fund better public transport
Fairness for workers who have to drive

phrases.meaning: fee for driving into busy areas
the main central part of a city
make fewer vehicles use the roads

model: I believe cities should charge drivers to enter the centre, provided there's a good alternative. First, it's one of the most effective ways to reduce traffic. London introduced a congestion charge back in 2003, and traffic in the zone dropped noticeably in the first few years. If Hanoi did something similar, the old quarter would be much less crowded, and there'd be less air pollution for the people who live there. I often avoid going into the city centre at weekends because it's so jammed, so I'd probably visit more if it were calmer. Another reason is that the city could reinvest the money in public transport. If they use the fees to add more buses and metro lines, more people will leave the car at home, and the system will keep improving. Some people worry it's unfair on drivers who have no choice, and that's why the charge should come with discounts for residents and deliveries. But overall, I think a charge would really pay off for everyone.
